name: Agentic AI Developer

exam.format: Proctored 120-minute assessment; the issuer says interactive components may occur.

scope: Agent architecture, tool use, memory/state, evaluation, multi-agent coordination and accountability inside production SDLC workflows.
ai_policy: Check the current exam resource policy. A coding-agent certification does not itself permit AI during the assessment.

domains.name: Prepare agent architecture and SDLC processes
Implement tool use and environment interaction
Perform evaluation, error analysis, and tuning

domains_note: Weights are midpoints of the published ranges (15–20%, 20–25%, 10–15%, 15–20%, 15–20%, 10–15%) from the Microsoft Learn GH-600 study guide (page updated 2026-05-13), read 2026-11-03.
